content.body:
The Lockheed 322-15 was a P-38F in foreign export service. In 1940, the French Air Force ordered hundreds of these excellent twin engined fighters which at the time were considered a very avante garde design.
The centerline guns package is very deadly, with almost unparalleled firepower due to the extremely tight grouping of the heavy caliber guns. The P-38 is a very large wingspan fighter design, being twin engined and having twin tail booms. It doesnt roll very fast and ailerons are heavy, however with some of the excellent and advanced fowler type wing flaps deployed, your turn rate can increase to a very significant degree, but be careful of the extra drag created because if you fail to get a guns solution early you will bleed off valuable speed if you continue to turn with flaps down for extended periods of time.
P-38s do not accelerate quickly or climb particularly fast, but they do enjoy good level speed at low altitudes and have excellent diving acceleration like most American designs.
Fly the P-38 in pairs with a wingman, stay fast and use speed and the very hard hitting guns package to do the job, avoid sustained turning fights unless you have the enemy outnumbered or you are certain of a victorious guns solution in the early part of the turning duel.
content.brief: TYPE: Fighter Interceptor CREW: 1 WEIGHT: 7216 kg MAX SPEED: 652 km/h ARMAMENT: 1 x 20mm Hispano Cannon 4 x .50 cal HMG
